name: iCE40 UltraPlus Breakout Board

programming.details: Programmed over USB (FTDI); Lattice proprietary tooling.

description: iCE40 UltraPlus breakout board that enables designers to evaluate key connectivity features of the iCE40 UltraPlus FPGA; brings out all I/Os and allows the FPGA to be programmed over a USB connector.
